# DTD Conformance Matrix

**Generated by `tests/conformance_matrix.rs`.** Do not hand-edit. Regenerate with `UPDATE_CONFORMANCE_MATRIX=1 cargo test --test conformance_matrix`. CI fails when this file drifts from the regenerated output.

Source DTD: `/System/Library/DTDs/sdef.dtd` (macOS 26.5, sha256 pinned in `tests/fixtures/sdef.dtd.sha256`).

## At a glance

- **25/25** DTD elements modelled.
- **103** DTD-declared attributes modelled (every attribute of every modelled element; verified by `tests/attribute_conformance.rs`).
- **8/8** closed-enum attributes surfaced as typed Rust enums; the remainder stay as `String` for forward compatibility (see *Known limitations* below).
- **25/25** elements exercised by ≥1 committed fixture under `tests/fixtures/`.

## Elements

One row per DTD element. Columns:

- **Required attrs** — DTD-declared `#REQUIRED` attributes.
- **Other attrs** — DTD-declared `#IMPLIED` attributes.
- **Typed enums** — closed-enum attributes that the parser surfaces as a typed Rust enum (rather than `String`). `(none)` is the common case.
- **mini / synthetic / extras** — whether the element appears in the named fixture under `tests/fixtures/`.

## Closed-enum attribute constraints

Attributes whose DTD type restricts the value to a fixed set. `Typed at parse time` is ✅ when the parser surfaces a typed Rust enum; ❌ when it accepts the value as a raw `String` (lenient by design — strict-mode parsing additionally rejects unknown values on entries marked ✅).

| Element . attribute | Allowed values | Typed at parse time |
|---|---|---|
| `access-group.access` | `r` \| `w` \| `rw` | ✅ |
| `accessor.style` | `index` \| `name` \| `id` \| `range` \| `relative` \| `test` | ✅ |
| `cocoa.boolean-value` | `YES` \| `NO` | ✅ |
| `contents.access` | `r` \| `w` \| `rw` | ✅ |
| `direct-parameter.requires-access` | `r` \| `w` \| `rw` | ✅ |
| `element.access` | `r` \| `w` \| `rw` | ✅ |
| `parameter.requires-access` | `r` \| `w` \| `rw` | ✅ |
| `property.access` | `r` \| `w` \| `rw` | ✅ |

## Known limitations

- **XInclude** (`<xi:include>`) is not resolved. Strict mode rejects it via [`Error::XIncludeUnsupported`]; lenient mode silently treats includes as no-ops. Resolve includes externally before parsing if needed.
- **Nested-list type expressions** (`<type list="yes">…<type list="yes"/>…`) are not represented as a recursive structure. Cocoa Scripting itself ignores nested lists; the limitation is documented inline on `TypeRef.list`.
- **Multi-OS DTD pinning**: only the macOS 26.5 `sdef.dtd` SHA-256 is hash-checked. Earlier macOS releases ship subsets of the DTD; the modelled AST is forward-compatible with the union as documented in the README.
- **Live-corpus coverage** is generated by the `corpus-macos.yml` workflow (weekly cron + workflow_dispatch) and uploaded as the `corpus-coverage` artifact. It is not part of this committed matrix because corpus availability depends on the runner image (system sdefs and which apps are installed).
